errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents different levels of cognitive states
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents percentages from 0% to 100%. The vertical axis represents the categories, which the description refers to as 'cognitive states'.

The categories on the vertical axis are "No Hallucination", "Oriented", "Active", "Self-aware", "Rigorous", and "Correct". "Matched" and "Not Matched" are the legend items representing the stacked segments of each bar, not categories themselves.
The categories on the vertical axis are not listed in alphabetical order. For example, 'Correct' comes before 'Rigorous' which comes before 'Self-aware'.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis displays the percentage match, ranging from 0% to 100%
errors.evidence: The vertical axis displays the categories. It is the horizontal axis that displays the percentage from 0% to 100%.

errors.text_span: The value axis is labeled "Matched / Not Matched"
errors.evidence: There is no axis labeled "Matched / Not Matched". This is the title of the legend, which explains the colors of the stacked bar segments.
The chart consists of six horizontal stacked bars, where each bar is composed of two segments: a dark blue one for "Matched" and a lighter blue one for "Not Matched".

errors.text_span: The bar for “Correct” reaches 99.00%, the “Not Matched” bar reaches 1.00%, and the “Matched” bar reaches 98.33%.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely misinterprets the chart's structure. It treats 'Matched' and 'Not Matched' as separate bars/categories. In reality, the 'Correct' bar has a 'Matched' component of 99.00%. The value 98.33% is the 'Matched' component for the 'No Hallucination' category, not a separate 'Matched' bar.

errors.text_span: The remaining bars for “Self-aware”, “Rigorous”, “Oriented”, and “Active” each have values around 97.33% and 97.00% respectively
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The 'Matched' values for 'Self-aware' and 'Rigorous' are 94.00% and 95.33% respectively, which are not close to 97%.

errors.text_span: All bars are presented in a uniform height
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, so the relevant dimension is length, not height. While all bars have the same total length (100%), describing them as having 'uniform height' is incorrect terminology for this chart type.

The description fails to identify the chart as a stacked bar chart and does not explain that each bar is composed of two segments ('Matched' and 'Not Matched') that sum to 100%. This is a fundamental omission of the chart's structure.
